site_name: 125 High Cross Road, Tottenham, London, N17 9NR
description: Site is Currently Class (E) use. The proposal is to start Nails and Beauty saloon. Whilst nail and beauty bars were historically classed as Sui Generis, following the changes to the use class regulations, it appears that a nail bar would fall within Class E(c)(iii). This is evident from a recent appeal decision where the Inspector debated this issue and reached this conclusion (paragraphs 6-9). Appeal Ref: APP/V5570/C/21/3277829. The recent planning decisions of our other clients suggest that local authorities across different areas in the England also classified Nail shops under Class E(c)(iii). The decision notices are attached with the application. Based on these it is requested to grant the "Certificate of Lawful Use or Development - Proposed Use or Development".
